text: FEME uses PostgreSQL as its primary database. The runtime applies idempotent migrations on startup. Extractor audit rows are kept for every ingested chunk.
The write governor enforces deduplication before committing claims. Evidence links store a support_type of either supports or corroborates. Schema migrations are numbered sequentially.
Claims extracted from official records receive higher initial confidence than those from secondary sources. The policy engine can override confidence scores at write time.
